content: Core CMMS features: work order management (create/assign/track with priority + status), preventive maintenance scheduling (time/usage/condition-based triggers), asset management (specs, maintenance history, manuals, warranty, spare parts), inventory/parts tracking, and maintenance reporting/cost breakdown. These form the standard feature set across UpKeep, MaintainX, Limble, SAP, IBM, Accruent, MRI.
